verdict: THE NULL SURVIVES A PROPER CONTROL. Reliability +0.3991 says the delta target has power, and on 569 CRISPR-validated pairs the validated enhancer beats a distance-matched random peak by only -0.0034. So Stage 1's conclusion holds for a better reason than it was originally reached: even real, perturbation-validated enhancers do not forecast their gene's expression change on this trajectory.
